extended:
**Chiral Lagrangians for Baryons Coupled to Massive Spin-1 Fields**

*B. Borasoy a 1 , Ulf-G. Meißner a 2*

26 pp, 14 sections.

**Abstract.** We analyze the eﬀective low–energy ﬁeld theory of Goldstone bosons and baryons chirally coupled to massive spin–1 ﬁelds. We use the electromagnetic baryon form factors to demonstrate the formal equivalence between the vector and the tensor ﬁeld formulation for the spin–1 ﬁelds. We also discuss the origin of the so–called Weinberg term in pion–nucleon scattering and the role of ρ–meson exchange. Chirally coupled vector mesons do not give rise to this two–pion nucleon seagull interaction but rather to higher order corrections. Some problems of the formal equivalence arising in higher orders and related to loops are touched upon.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Effective Lagrangian of Goldstones, Baryons ; 2.1 Addition of Spin--1 Fields: Tensor Field F; 2.2 Addition of Spin--1 Fields: Vector Field F; 2.3 Equivalence for Spin--1 Pole Contributions; 3 Electromagnetic Form Factors for the Baryon ; 3.1 Basic Definitions; 3.2 Vector Meson Contribution to the Electroma; 4 Vector Meson Contribution to Pion--Nucleon S; 5 Loops with massive particles; 6 Short Summary; A Construction Principles; B On the Equivalence from Dual Transformations
